svg.aria-label: How a full disk made OpenVidu route every recording to the one node that couldn't record, in six phases: healthy cluster, media-node-1 disk fills up, the paradox (score 1.0), every recording goes to node 1, every recording fails with EGRESS_FAILED, and the fix (a min_disk_space_mb check makes node 1 reject work so egress flows to the healthy nodes)
svg.title: How a full disk made OpenVidu route every recording to the one node that couldn't record, in six phases: healthy cluster, media-node-1 disk fills up, the paradox (score 1.0), every recording goes to node 1, every recording fails with EGRESS_FAILED, and the fix (a min_disk_space_mb check makes node 1 reject work so egress flows to the healthy nodes)

svg.text: to the one node that couldn't record
Egress node selection uses a "cpuload" affinity score: the node reporting the most free CPU wins.

the user's side, the whole cluster stops recording.
